info.name: Amazon WorkSpaces Web BrowserSettings API
info.description:
WorkSpaces Web is a low cost, fully managed WorkSpace built specifically to facilitate secure, web-based workloads. WorkSpaces Web makes it easy for customers to safely provide their employees with access to internal websites and SaaS web applications without the administrative burden of appliances or specialized client software. WorkSpaces Web provides simple policy tools tailored for user interactions, while offloading common tasks like capacity management, scaling, and maintaining browser images.

item.name: Amazon WorkSpaces Web Create Browser Settings

request.description: Creates a browser settings resource that can be associated with a web portal. Once associated with a web portal, browser settings control how the browser will behave once a user starts a streaming session for the web portal.
